title: Constraints
description: What one group member wants, extracted from their voice note or text. Only include what the member actually said; use empty arrays, empty string, or null when something was not mentioned. Never invent preferences.

memberName.description: The member's name exactly as provided by the app.

freeWindows.description: Times the member said they are free. Resolve relative days ("Friday night") against the reference date given in the prompt. Empty if no time was mentioned.

start.description: ISO 8601 datetime with UTC offset in America/Chicago, e.g. 2026-10-30T19:00:00-05:00.

end.description: ISO 8601 datetime with UTC offset in America/Chicago. Must be after start.

budgetPerPerson.description: Spending range in USD per person. Use null for a bound that was not stated ("under $30" gives min null, max 30; "free stuff" gives min 0, max 0).

vibe.description: Short lowercase tags for the kind of outing, e.g. "live music", "outdoors", "chill", "cozy", "active", "late night", "food", "drinks", "games", "movies".

dietary.description: Short lowercase dietary needs, e.g. "vegetarian", "vegan", "gluten-free", "halal", "no alcohol".

accessibility.description: Short lowercase accessibility needs, e.g. "wheelchair accessible", "needs seating", "quiet", "step-free".

area.description: Preferred Austin neighborhood or area, e.g. "East Austin", "South Congress", "Downtown". Empty string if no preference.

transport.description: How the member can get there. Empty if not mentioned.

rawTranscript.description: The full transcript or typed text, verbatim.
